newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end weaker, eyes on Buba.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end weaker, eyes on Buba.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed easier in line with Bonos as the weakening of the Iberian currencies against the mark opened the possibility of spreads against 10-year Bunds exceeding 90 basis points (bp), dealers said.
"Portuguese bonds eased with Spain after the two Iberian currencies felt some profit taking, losing ground against the mark," said one operator.
Another said: "Shorter bonds are well-supported, but 10-year bonds could see spreads against Bunds rise above 90 bp."
Dealers said the market was anxiously awaiting the results of tomorrow's Bundesbank meeting.
The escudo eased against the mark to close at 99.70/73 per mark.
